SCENE 3

Film talk

TASKAnswer the questions.

Personally, I’d say…I tend to…It depends on…I’m not a big fan of…What I find is…To be honest…
  1. What kind of films do you like most? What kind can’t you stand?
  2. Do you prefer watching alone or with other people? Why?
  3. Is there a film that changed the way you think?
  4. Do you have a “comfort film” that you watch again and again?
  5. Have you ever walked out of a film or stopped watching? What happened?
  6. Do films affect our mental health? In a good way or a bad way?
  7. Subtitles or dubbing? Does it change the film for you?
  8. Why do people love sad films, scary films or films that make them cry?

      SCENE 10

      Just chat

      A · Casting director

      TASKImagine you are the directors of your own movie or TV show. Some actors came to audition and you need to pick the best one for each role. Discuss who suits better.

      A single mother of 4 fighting for the custody of her children

      A serial killer whose MO (mode of operation) is unlike any other’s

      A malicious witch who invaded a peaceful kingdom

      A very bright and gifted child who is being bullied at school

      A rather influential and extremely loaded businessman experiencing some crisis in his family

      An attractive high-maintenance girl who nobody takes seriously

      A mad scientist who invents an AI which is going to take over the world

      B · Behind the scenes

      TASKWhat’s going on in these photos? What movies can you recognize? Who is preparing for what, and how? How does it make you feel? Do these pictures diminish the magic of the special effects, make-up or movie sets? Why are some of them funny?

      C · Talk about a TV series

      TASKTalk about a TV series, soap opera or sitcom that…

      was the first one you watched entirely in English
      was downright silly yet oddly satisfying to watch
      you strongly associate with your childhood / teenagehood
      was unfairly cancelled instead of being renewed for a new season
      kept you on the edge of your seat
      you watched just to see what all the hype was about
      didn’t live up to your high expectations
      is your favourite non-English production
      was enjoyable language-wise
